text:
- Generate Fibonacci numbers iteratively starting from 1, 1 (or 0, 1) and track unique Fibonacci values ≥ 2; for each new Fibonacci number, check if it’s prime; increment a counter when both conditions (Fibonacci and prime) are met until reaching the n-th.
- Implement a fast primality test for integers (handle small cases, then trial division up to sqrt(n) using 2 and odd divisors).
- Edge cases: if n ≤ 0 raise a ValueError; ensure large Fibonacci numbers don’t overflow typical loops and stop once the n-th prime Fibonacci is found; return the found value.
